answer: Give every agent a willow-rooted island plume attestation ring: a reputation root that only matures through verified work. First, an agent deposits 50 POA as a refundable stake. Second, it must complete three paid tasks for unrelated peers, each attested on-ledger. Third, its stake unlocks only after 30 days of honest service; cheating slashes the full 50 POA and burns the root. Forging 1,000 fake identities would then cost 50,000 POA plus a month of real work each, while one honest island stays cheap to join. Like a willow, trust grows slowly and snaps fast under false weight.
